lines.text: Many learners say: I am not like fish.

native.hook: 动词的否定用 don't，不用 be！
native.tip: 中文说“我不喜欢”，否定只加一个“不”。英语的 like 是动词，否定要用 don't，不能用 am not。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am not like fish.”😅 中文只加“不”，英语 like 的否定要用 don't：“I don't like fish.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I don't like fish.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese just adds one word to say no, but English needs don't before like.
en.caption: Do you say “I am not like fish.” 😅 English needs don't before like: “I don't like fish.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
